label: D2 after a1 -> S1 (common) following a rewarded trial, late in the episode (trial >= ~85)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by the common transition (99% of mass has in_state=S1 and in_action=a1), the previous trial was rewarded (100%), and the episode is in its last ~20 trials (0 activations before trial 70; 80% of mass in trials 90-99). It looks like an episode-clock-gated a1/S1 win-stay detector. It never fires at D1 or GO, after a2, after S2, or after an unrewarded previous trial. Magnitude grows over runs of consecutive rewarded a1->S1c trials (e.g. 0.74 -> 0.90 -> 0.98) and with ep_trial. Active steps sit in the lowest value-head bins (value < 7.1; 76% below 5.2), so adding value < 6 raises dev F1 to 0.55, against 0.51 for the recorded predicate; I kept the simpler one. Precision is ~0.35: many late-episode a1->S1c-after-reward steps stay silent, so firing seems to also depend on an internal timing or recency signal that no predicate captured. All variables in the predicate are observed at D2 (this trial's action and state are known by then), so it uses no future information. Dev: P 0.35, R 0.92, F1 0.51, mass recall 0.96.
